name: isFlushed
description: Returns true once the HTTP response has been committed by a cfflush, i.e. whether output has been flushed to the client. This is the same flag that decides whether cfheader, cfcontent or cflocation can still take effect. Outside a streaming web response (for example under the CLI) nothing is ever committed, so it reports false.

examples.title: Check the flush state
examples.description: True after a cfflush has committed the response.
